parts.name: Cover
parts.Basic_description: This is the cover of a trash can, made of durable plastic with a handle on top for easy lifting.
parts.Functional_description: The cover prevents odors from escaping and keeps the contents of the trash can concealed. It can be lifted or removed to dispose of waste.
parts.Movement_description: The cover can be lifted vertically or rotated open depending on the hinge or handle design.

parts.name: Container
parts.Basic_description: This is the main container body of the trash can, made of plastic and designed to hold waste materials.
parts.Functional_description: The container stores the trash and supports the cover. It is designed to be easy to clean and durable for repeated use.
parts.Movement_description: The container itself is stationary during normal use but can be lifted or tilted for emptying.
